name: Infer: GPUStack (control plane)
short_desc: GPUStack GPU cluster manager: web UI, model catalog, vLLM/SGLang runners, Grafana
author: Morteza Rastgoo
description: GPUStack v2.3.1 server with the embedded worker. You deploy models from the web UI (admin / the generated password in the app settings). The worker starts each model as a separate runner container (vLLM, SGLang, ...) through the Docker socket. Built-in Prometheus + Grafana dashboards and an OpenAI-compatible gateway. Caution: the runner containers that GPUStack creates do not join the host NVIDIA MPS daemon (no uid 1000, no /tmp/nvidia-mps), so on this Exclusive_Process GPU they can only start while the host vLLM and its MPS daemon are stopped. The data dir uses the same path inside and outside the container so runner containers can mount model files from it.

form_fields.label: Models directory (host)
form_fields.hint: Host folder with your model weights. It is mounted read-only at the same path.

form_fields.label: Admin password
form_fields.hint: Generated at install. Log in as `admin`.
